description:
What You Can Expect
 As a Full Stack Developer at Zoom, you will take end-to-end ownership of features and services that reach users worldwide, from design through deployment, monitoring, and production support. This role spans backend engineering, frontend development, and applied AI, offering you the chance to build meaningful, scalable solutions across the full technology stack. You will work with autonomy and collaborate closely with cross-functional partners who value craft, curiosity, and continuous improvement. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2–3 days per week at our San Jose, CA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.

 About the Team
 You will join a team of engineers building systems that support Zoom's platform at scale, working across backend services, intelligent APIs, and AI-enabled workflows. The team values end-to-end ownership, technical rigor, and a collaborative approach to solving complex problems. You will partner closely with product, design, and infrastructure partners to ship features that make a real difference to how people connect and collaborate.

 Responsibilities
 Build scalable full stack applications using Java, Spring Boot, modern frontend frameworks (React, Angular, TypeScript), REST and GraphQL APIs, and relational and NoSQL databases.
 Design and maintain robust backend services and APIs with a focus on performance, security, and long-term reliability.
 Build and integrate AI and LLM-based solutions including AI agents, RAG pipelines, tool calling, and prompt-based workflows, with working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP).
 Own features from end to end, covering design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
 Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the full stack, including frontend, backend, APIs, and database layers.
 Apply AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar to accelerate delivery and improve code quality.
 
 What We're Looking For
 5–8 years of software development experience with proven full stack expertise.
 Hands-on proficiency with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices architecture.
 Experience building frontend applications with React, Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript, or equivalent frameworks.
 Strong knowledge of SQL databases, data modeling, and query optimization, plus familiarity with NoSQL databases.
 Working knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, RAG, prompt engineering, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
 Practical experience with AWS or comparable cloud platforms, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Git, OAuth2, RBAC, and application security fundamentals.
 Solid grasp of system design, distributed systems, scalability principles, and engineering best practices, with the ability to drive features independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.
 
 
 Salary Range or On Target Earnings: 
 
 Minimum:
$98,900.00 
 Maximum:
$228,700.00

 
 In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value. 
 
 Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience. 
 
 We also have a location based compensation structure;  there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations 
 At Zoom, we offer a window of at least 5 days for you to apply because we believe in giving you every opportunity. Below is the potential closing date, just in case you want to mark it on your calendar. We look forward to receiving your application! 
 
 Anticipated Position Close Date: 





















10/12/26
 Ways of Working 
Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting.

 Benefits 
As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Click Learn for more information.

 About Us 
Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars.
We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.
 
 Our Commitment 
 At Zoom, we believe great work happens when people feel supported and empowered. We’re committed to fair hiring practices that ensure every candidate is evaluated based on skills, experience, and potential. If you require an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know—we’re here to support you at every step.
 
If you need assistance navigating the interview process due to a medical disability, please submit an Accommodations Request Form and someone from our team will reach out soon. This form is solely for applicants who require an accommodation due to a qualifying medical disability. Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed.

 Our interviews are supported by BrightHire, a tool that helps us create a consistent and thoughtful interview experience and may include recordings. Please refer to our candidate privacy statement for more information of how we use your data.
